card.name: Linking words after verbs of supplying
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, by, the, of, into, in) right after a verb or noun about moving, supplying or planting something, in plant, food and nutrition text. The next word is the recipient or place.

modes.label: Direction or place word
modes.description: A word like to, by or into follows a verb of carrying, planting or introducing, and points to a destination.
modes.example: who suggested transporting it<< to>> the West Indies to feed the enslaved Africans

modes.label: Benefit or target word
modes.description: The or of follows a verb or noun about nourishing or supplying a body part or condition.
modes.example: blood circulation, opening the channels and collaterals, and nourishing<< the>> muscles and tendons.

card.plain: It fires on little linking words like "to" or "by" after verbs about carrying, supplying or planting something, just before the destination or beneficiary is named.
